name: Rescue 1122
description: Emergency rescue and ambulance service. Call if you or someone near you is in immediate danger.

name: Police emergency, 15
description: For immediate danger where police help is needed.

name: Umang mental health helpline
description: A Pakistan-based helpline for emotional support, reported to be free and open around the clock. Numbers listed online differ between sources, so check the current one on their website.

name: Pakistan Centre for Autism
description: Assessment, therapy and parent training for autistic people and others with neurodevelopmental differences. Services appear to be mainly for children.

name: Kazim Anwar ADHD Trust
description: A not-for-profit working on ADHD and learning differences such as dyslexia, with screening and workshops for families and teachers.

name: Autism centre at PIMS
description: News reports describe a public autism centre at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences offering assessment and therapies. Confirm services and whether adults are seen before visiting.

name: South Asian ADHD peer support group (ADDA)
description: An online peer group for South Asian adults with ADHD, run by the Attention Deficit Disorder Association. Membership of ADDA may be required.
